c2.title: Clover Garland Necklace
c2.descriptionHtml:
A garland of red clovers. Small four petal clovers, each four round red stones in gold tone cups with a fine beaded rim around one small clear stone at the centre, are linked petal to petal by fine gold rings all the way round the neck.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone with an open neckline, or with the Clover Garland Bracelet in white.

Details

  • Clovers: Approximately 10mm across, linked petal to petal by small gold tone rings
  • Stones: Four round red cubic zirconia petals per clover, approximately 3.5mm, around a small clear centre stone
  • Colour: Red
  • Setting: Gold tone cups with a fine beaded rim
  • Length: Approximately 42cm (to confirm)
  • Finish: Polished gold tone
  • Material: Stainless steel, as on the supplier's card

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

a14.title: Solitaire Charm Huggies
a14.descriptionHtml:
One stone on a slim hoop. Each earring is a slim polished gold tone huggie of about 13mm with a charm threaded on it, a small square gold tone tube and a round clear cubic zirconia of about 6mm in four fine claws hanging below it.

STYLING TIP: Pair them with the Petite Pear Solitaire Necklace.

Details

  • Hoop: Approximately 13mm, slim and plain, with a hinged snap
  • Charm: A small square gold tone tube on the hoop and a round clear cubic zirconia, approximately 6mm, in four claws
  • Length: Approximately 22mm from the top of the hoop to the bottom of the stone
  • Sold as: One pair
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

a16.title: V-Bar Teardrop Necklace
a16.descriptionHtml:
A polished V and one clear drop. A dense gold tone wheat chain about 3.5mm wide, its small bright cut links set in a tight chevron, turns into two smooth gold tone bars that meet in a V at the front, and a pear cut clear cubic zirconia of about 10 x 13mm hangs point up from the point of the V.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone with a white top or a deep neckline.

Details

  • Chain: Dense wheat chain of small bright cut links set in a chevron, approximately 3.5mm wide
  • Front: Two polished bars, approximately 15mm each, meeting in a V
  • Drop: Pear cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 10 x 13mm, hanging point up in a claw setting
  • Length: Approximately 45cm (to confirm)
  • Material: 316L stainless steel with a PVD gold tone finish, as labelled by the supplier

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

a13.title: Slim Pave Huggies
a13.descriptionHtml:
A line of light down a slim rectangle. Gold tone huggies of about 18mm, shaped as a rectangle with softly rounded corners, set down the front with a row of round clear cubic zirconia in raised claws and a row of tiny stones down the outer side, close with a hinged snap.

STYLING TIP: Stack them with the Brushed Gold Huggies.

Details

  • Size: Approximately 18mm tall and 10mm deep, about 2mm wide
  • Stones: Round clear cubic zirconia down the front, each in raised claws, with a row of tiny stones down the outer side
  • Closure: Hinged snap
  • Sold as: One pair
  • Finish: Polished gold tone
  • Material: Stainless steel, as on the supplier's card

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
